name: Chaffery for WooCommerce
author: chaffery

sections.description:
Know their price.

Shoppers tell you what they would pay. You see how many are interested at each price.

Give them a reason to return.

When your price meets theirs, Chaffery sends an alert. They can buy in your store, through your checkout.

Make it fit.

Add an optional “Name your price” button to the products you list on Chaffery. Choose its words and where it appears.

The plugin is free. A Chaffery account is required. Product listing is a paid service with a free trial. See Chaffery for details.

External services

This plugin connects to Chaffery, operated by the plugin’s author.

  • Connection checks send only your shop’s address to https://chaffery.com/api/woo/listed. They check your connection and live products when you open the settings or request a check. While the button is on, they also run in the background, after saving settings and when a shop manager visits a product page.
  • “Name your price” opens https://chaffery.com/go/woo with your shop’s address, the product ID and language.
  • “Connect this store” opens https://sellers.chaffery.com with your shop’s address. WooCommerce sends Chaffery a read-only key after you approve it. Chaffery reads product names, descriptions, photos, prices and stock.

The plugin does not send customer or order records. The button is off by default. No checks run while it is off unless you open the plugin’s settings or request a check.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Open WooCommerce → Chaffery and select Connect this store. Sign in to Chaffery and approve the read-only connection in WordPress.
  3. Choose the products you want to list in Chaffery.
  4. Back in WooCommerce → Chaffery, turn on Show the button on product pages and select Save changes.
sections.faq:
Does Chaffery change my store?

The connection is read-only. Chaffery does not edit your products, prices or orders. Shoppers complete their purchases in your store.

Where does the button appear?

On products that are live on Chaffery, once you turn it on. Place it below the price or the add-to-cart button.

Why is the button missing?

Open WooCommerce → Chaffery. Check that your store is connected, the product is live and the button is on. Select Check connection or Check again to refresh. Changes can take time to appear. Clear your page cache if needed.

Custom templates and page builders may need the [chaffery_button] shortcode. With manual placement, add it where you want the button to appear.

Can shoppers see the setup notes on product pages?

No. Only signed-in shop managers see these notes.

Does it add cookies or tracking?

The plugin adds no cookies or tracking to your shop. It loads no scripts on your storefront. The button opens Chaffery only when clicked.

What happens if I remove the plugin?

The button disappears and checks stop. Deleting the plugin also removes its saved settings.

Your Chaffery account and store connection stay active. To disconnect, use your Chaffery dashboard or revoke the key under WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.

  • Make connection checks more reliable.
